verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated account balances API that returns live, real-time balances. Its marketing explicitly positions these 'guaranteed live account balances' for underwriting and for ensuring sufficient funds before submitting an ACH debit, which matches the NSF/risk-check use case. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that balances are truly live at request time, and documented endpoint details in the evidence (response fields, available vs. ledger distinction, latency/freshness guarantees).
